validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION/ATTRIBUTION: CONFIRMED independently. The Qatif Program (Qatif-Abu Sa'fah development, Saudi Aramco, Eastern Province) routes associated SOUR GAS from the Qatif field to the Berri Gas Plant (Al Jubail) for processing. Oil & Gas Journal (Berri gas processing facility expansion) states verbatim the Berri plant 'is being expanded to handle increased output of sour gas from Qatif field, now being developed in eastern Saudi Arabia' (Technip-Coflexip added a sweetening unit + sulfur recovery; sulfur recovery rose to 3,300 t/day). Offshore-Technology (Qatif-Abu Sa'fah) and Wikipedia (Qatif Project) independently confirm Qatif field gas -> Berri Gas Plant, ~330-370 MMscfd associated gas, owner Saudi Aramco, Eastern Province. So the entity is real, it is genuinely a GAS (dry-gas/sour-gas) transmission/feeder line (not NGL/oil/water), endpoints Qatif -> Berri Gas Plant (Al Jubail, Eastern Province) are correct, and Owner1 = Saudi Aramco 100% is correct. No DUPLICATE: no other roster row shares the Qatif->Berri endpoints (P1904 Tanajib-Berri, P1906 Abqaiq-Berri, P1898/P1899 UBTG-Berri, P1921/P7768 Abu Ali-Berri are all distinct origins). SPEC CONCERN: the specific LengthKnown=45 km and Diameter=32 in could NOT be independently corroborated. The only gem.wiki citation harvested was OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin 2012 p.75 (a country-level statistics bulletin, not a pipeline-specific spec source). Independent searches (en + targeted) surface only the program-level pipeline figures (e.g. ~450 km of total project pipelines; 12-30 in OIL flowlines / WATER injection lines per OGJ 'Berri, Qatif pipeline work') and never a 45 km / 32-in dry-gas line. These specs match the known single-origin pattern of the GEM small-Saudi-gas cluster (P1897-P1925) rather than a value confirmed by two independent sources. Per the standing rule (a page mentioning the pipeline is not enough; the source must AGREE with the GEM number), length and diameter remain medium/low and should not be greened on current evidence.

fills.researcher_notes: Qatif Program is producing/processing (gas flowing from Qatif field to Berri Gas Plant); the Berri plant was expanded to handle this Qatif sour gas and the development is operational. Two independent sources support an operating status.
Commodity = Gas confirmed: OGJ states the line/plant handle 'sour gas from Qatif field'; Offshore-Technology confirms gas from Qatif is sent to Berri Gas Plant. Not an NGL/oil/water line.
FuelSource = Qatif (the Qatif field) confirmed by both sources: gas originates in the Qatif field and is sent to Berri for processing.

Endpoints confirmed: Qatif field (origin) -> Berri Gas Plant, located in Al Jubail, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. Both sources place Qatif and the Berri Gas Plant in eastern Saudi Arabia with gas routed from Qatif to Berri.
Owner = Saudi Aramco 100% confirmed: the Qatif Program is a wholly Saudi Aramco development; both sources attribute the Qatif field gas / Berri Gas Plant to Saudi Aramco.

Could not corroborate 45 km from any independent source. Program-level sources cite ~450 km total project pipelines and 12-30 in oil/water lines, never a 45 km gas line. Single-origin (matches the GEM small-Saudi-gas cluster pattern); left blank rather than cite a non-agreeing source. No fabricated URL.

Could not corroborate 32-in from any independent source. The only diameter figures found in independent sources are 12-30 in oil flowlines / water injection lines (OGJ 'Berri, Qatif pipeline work'), which are NOT this gas line. No fabricated URL; left UNRESOLVED.

summary: P1916 Qatif North-Berri gas line is REAL and correctly classified (Aramco sour gas, Qatif field -> Berri Gas Plant, Eastern Province; all greened high). SPEC CONCERN: 45 km length and 32-in diameter are single-origin and not independently corroborable - left UNRESOLVED.
